P.text: Market init seeds lastETWAPBaseSupply to 0, and the first mint does not update the stored exponential TWAP before _checkMintCap enforces limits.
P.evidence_quote: the exchange state seeds `lastETWAPBaseSupply` to `0`, and the first mint does not update the stored exponential TWAP before `_checkMintCap` enforces limits

I.text: Mint cap check should compare live supply against a properly updated ETWAP so follow-up mints after crossing the noCapLimit threshold are not blocked.
I.evidence_quote: the system compares the live supply against a near-zero TWAP, so any follow-up mint after the threshold must fail until the ETWAP catches up

V.text: The first minter to cross the noCapLimit threshold permanently trips the mint cap until ETWAP decays, causing denial of service for depositors and blocking new deposits for roughly an hour.
V.evidence_quote: the first minter to cross the `noCapLimit` threshold will permanently trip the mint cap until the ETWAP decays
